subject: Air freight quote to DEL
body:
Hi,

Could you quote your cheapest air freight option to DEL (Delhi, IN), all-in in EUR, including trucking from our site at 36563 (Fulda), Germany, to the airport?

The electronic control units will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28: 5 pieces, 356 kg gross, 1.58 cbm.

Please attach the offer as a PDF to your reply so our purchasing department can file it.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
